note: Self-employed consultant also starting a woodworking business, so he qualifies as a business owner or equivalent, though loosely. He is a clean match on starting point: he wants variety, efficiency and 'a better overall, like, efficiency, effectiveness, sort of, overhaul' from a base that already works, which is the good-to-great arc almost verbatim, and he is nowhere near the deconditioned gym-averse exclusion — formerly a lot more overweight, now training six days a week and rucking. He fails hard on neglected_health, and fails it in the unusual direction: health is not the neglected area of his life, it is the organising project of it. Meditation, the five Tibetan rites, a year on a supervised elimination protocol, wearable recovery scores in the nineties, deliberate sun exposure at every meal. That is the criterion doing exactly what it is written to do, and it is the criterion the rep used to disqualify — correctly. Income was never tested and is therefore recorded in neither list: no price objection arose because the rep declined to sell before any negotiation, and the prospect did not react to the $6,000 figure at all when it was named. This is the one call in the batch where the stated ICP was applied live, out loud and to the company's cost, and where it produced the right answer.
